question:
I am using dbt in our data pipelines. I have this sources.yml and I want to return only <database>.<schema> like my_project.my_schema

How do I do that using Jinja?

sources:
  - name: my_source
    schema: my_schema
    description: My database
    database: my_project

    tables:
      - name: items
title: Get only schema in dbt sources.yml
answer:
Let's use include method in the Relation dbt Classes

{{ source('my_source', 'items').include(identifier=False) }}

Similarly if you'd like to exclude:

  • database: {{ source('my_source', 'items').include(database=False) }}
  • schema: {{ source('my_source', 'items').include(schema=False) }}

But anyway, I'm curious of what purpose is? Hope this helps!
